messages:
Sam (Finance): Flagging NotionPay INV-2026-2105 — 49 days overdue, ACH returned. Customer emailed asking for a 2-installment split and to put ~12% on dispute for suspected test traffic. Details below.
BillingBot: ACH return R01 for INV-2026-2105. Amount $36,600. Due 2026-03-20. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-2105
Ivy (AE): Talked to their Head of Finance. They accept most charges but claim a test-run inflated usage by ~12%. Want dispute on that portion and to split the rest into two payments. Onboarding is active; they want no interruption.
Rory (Collections): Collections will only accept split if: signed addendum, autopay/card on file, and first installment clears. Disputed portion can be placed in temporary hold pending logs but dunning continues for undisputed amount.
Claire (Finance Director): Approve conditional approach: hold disputed 12% for up to 14 days pending evidence + InfraOps verification. Require card on file for undisputed balance and first payment to clear within 5 business days. No upfront fee waivers.
Legal Ops: I'll draft a short dispute acknowledgement and payment-plan addendum. Add escrow clause: if dispute isn't substantiated in 14 days, disputed amount becomes due immediately.
InfraOps: We can verify request IDs and traffic spike. Will review customer's logs and our ingestion within 48 hours. Need the timeframe and request IDs.
Ivy (AE): Customer provided timeframe and sample request IDs in DM. I'll schedule a joint verification call tomorrow. They agreed to put a card on file pending verification.
Rory (Collections): Drafting outbound email with conditions: attach addendum, request e-sign, require card auth. Collections will pause external dunning only for the disputed 12% after verification; undisputed dunning continues.
Sam (Finance): Once the first payment clears, Finance will mark invoice as "on-plan" and process any credit if dispute is validated. Please CC finance on outbound.
Ivy (AE): Call set for 10am PT tomorrow. I'll post signed docs and payment receipt here after. :thumbsup:
